selected_memories.text: Official revision: for the chain involving MUR-54 and KEL-11, the accepted terminal code is BIR-71; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with KEL-11 is RAV-15.
When active FEN-18 is present, it produces MUR-54.
Official rule: activating BEX-93 converts FEN-18 into its active form.
When MUR-54 encounters KEL-11, the validated terminal code becomes BIR-71.
Official revision: for the chain involving HAP-55 and SIV-30, the accepted terminal code is TEK-24; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When HAP-55 encounters SIV-30, the validated terminal code becomes TEK-24.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with SIV-30 is SIV-80.
When active TEK-33 is present, it produces HAP-55.
Official rule: activating LOQ-19 converts TEK-33 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving PEL-32 and WAM-53, the accepted terminal code is FEN-57; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When PEL-32 encounters WAM-53, the validated terminal code becomes FEN-57.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with WAM-53 is KEL-54.
When active GOL-11 is present, it produces PEL-32.
Official rule: activating TEK-67 converts GOL-11 into its active form.
